name: Persistence
overview: Scripture teaches that persistence is a vital Christian virtue, demonstrated by the righteous who rise again after multiple falls, unlike the wicked who succumb to ruin (Proverbs 24:16). Jesus encourages persistent prayer and seeking, assuring that continual asking, seeking, and knocking will be rewarded (Luke 11:5, 9; Luke 18:1). Believers are exhorted not to grow weary in doing good, for perseverance will bring a harvest in due time (Galatians 6:9). Furthermore, confidence is grounded in the promise that God, who began a good work in believers, will faithfully complete it until Christ's return (Philippians 1:6).
